case.title: Poly Network LockProxy, Ethereum, 10 Aug 2021
case.period: hack: baseline before the incident, then the drain
case.notes: Keeper swapped via EthCrossChainManager 0x838bf9e95cb12dd76a54c9f9d2e3082eaf928270 (tx 0xb1f70464..., block 12,996,659), then forged unlocks. First theft is native: 2,857.49 ETH left LockProxy in tx 0xad7a2c70c958fcd3effbf374d0acf3774a9257577625ae4c838e24b0de17602a (block 12,996,671, 09:51:02 UTC). First tracked theft: 96,389,444 USDC (block 12,996,694). Then WBTC, DAI, UNI, SHIB, renBTC, 33.4M USDT, 26,109 WETH, FEI, all to the attacker. Funds were returned.
case.coverage: Tracked: USDT, USDC, DAI, WBTC, WETH, UNI, FEI, renBTC. Not tracked: 2,857 native ETH (~$9M); 259.7B SHIB (no Chainlink SHIB feed existed in Aug 2021); small project tokens (MOZ, O3, STACK...). Ethereum leg was ~$273M of the ~$611M multi-chain total.

source: Ethereum mainnet via public JSON-RPC (https://rpc.mevblocker.io, https://gateway.tenderly.co); built by research/bridge-hacks/03-onchain-data/fetch_more.py
price_note: USDT fixed $1; USDC fixed $1; DAI fixed $1; WBTC at Chainlink BTC / USD 46,002; WETH at Chainlink ETH / USD 3,152.69; UNI at Chainlink UNI / USD 29.7599; FEI at Chainlink FEI / USD 1.00185; renBTC ASSUMED = Chainlink BTC/USD 46,002.00 (no own feed; BTC-pegged wrapper, upper bound) (answers at block 12996671). Native ETH is not included except where it passed through WETH (rows with kind weth_wrap / weth_unwrap).
